The Lord Of The Rings: The Rings Of Power Seasons 1 & 2 Releasing On 4k UHD, Blu-ray, DVD Plus Limited SteelBook Editions

By HD Report
September 7, 2026
0
Facebook
ReddIt
Pinterest
Copy URL
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 0:53
    Instaread

    Amazon MGM Studios’ The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power – Seasons One and Two are finally releasing in physical media formats! The seasons have been packaged in Limited Edition SteelBooks with exclusive slipcases and collectible art cards.

    Update: Pre-orders are now available on Amazon US (Dec. 2, 2026) and Amazon UK (Dec. 1, 2026).

    The disc release of the first two seasons anticipate the premiere of Season Three of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power on November 11, 2026.

    Description: An ensemble cast of characters, both familiar and new, must confront the re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains to the majestic forests of Lindon; from the island kingdom of Númenor, to the furthest reaches of the map, these realms and characters will forge legacies that will live on long after they’re gone.
